component.name: rtify
component.summary: Spotify client with a terminal look

description.p: rtify plays Spotify on the Linux desktop, through its own built-in player or any other Spotify Connect device. It browses your library, playlists, albums and artists, edits playlists, and shows synced lyrics from LRCLIB.

ul.li: System24 look for OLED screens: true black, framed panels, one pastel accent
Synced and word-timed lyrics with romanization for Japanese, Korean, Chinese and Cyrillic
Built-in Spotify Connect player with sound through PipeWire or PulseAudio
Tray icon, global shortcuts and MPRIS media controls
Accent colors from the album cover or a Noctalia template

description.p: rtify needs a Spotify Premium account.
Library sorting with your own order, a heart column in track lists, a fuller song menu.
Rebindable keys with mute, framed player bar controls, animated notifications.
New look and layout: mint accent, three resizable columns, home, search and new releases views, settings inside the main window.
Built-in player: rtify plays on this computer as a Spotify Connect device of its own.
